lookup_coco_category_index: look up the internal category index for a COCO category name using the coco_categories dictionary
reverse_lookup_coco_category_name: reverse lookup a COCO category name from its internal index using coco_category_id_to_coco_category
map_coco_official_to_internal: map a COCO official category ID to the internal category index using coco_categories_mapping
get_category_color: get the RGB color palette values for a detection category from coco_categories_color_palette
review_coco_categories_constants: review the coco_categories, coco_categories_mapping, and coco_categories_color_palette constant definitions
